asset_ownership: Reviewed terms establish service-provider and validator participation but do not establish one universal legal-title model for all supported assets.
rehypothecation: CoinSwitch states EARN does not lend or loan user crypto to third parties; reviewed material supports staking/validator use rather than lending-based rehypothecation.
withdrawal_terms: CoinSwitch states users may unlock supported EARN assets, subject to product and blockchain mechanics.
counterparty_risk: Exposure includes CoinSwitch/Bitcipher operational risk, validator risk and underlying protocol risk.
notes: Do not generalize ordinary wallet custody protections or infer insolvency priority from the reviewed EARN materials.
